name: Amazon Neptune (Database, Neptune Analytics, RDF/SPARQL mode)
tier_reason: Required supported backend of EOIP (BL-04); also covers C02 'Amazon Neptune (RDF mode)' (same engine, cross-referenced)
latest_version: Neptune Database engine 1.5.0.0 (Gremlin/TinkerPop 3.8.0-3.8.1, openCypher Neptune-9.0.20190305-1.1, SPARQL 1.1); Neptune Analytics: managed, unversioned; graph-notebook 5.3.0
release_cadence: Engine patch/minor releases roughly monthly to quarterly; minor versions available >=6 months, major >=12 months; 1.2.x EOL 2026-12-04
license: Proprietary AWS managed service (AWS Customer Agreement / Service Terms); client tooling Apache-2.0 (graph-notebook, TinkerPop drivers)
redistribution_notes: Not embeddable or redistributable; runs only in the customer's AWS account. Client libraries Apache-2.0. Reselling Neptune capacity inside an EOIP offering requires commercial review of AWS Service Terms.
legal_review_reason: No copyleft in client code; commercial (not licence) review only if EOIP resells capacity; benchmark-publication terms UNVERIFIED
community_vs_enterprise: Single managed product; capabilities split across Neptune Database vs Neptune Analytics (separate service, openCypher-only, algorithms + vector index)
resolution_note: C02 'Amazon Neptune (RDF mode)' is the same engine (RDF and LPG data isolated at query time) - covered here. Neptune Analytics is openCypher-only; EOIP manifest (adapters/manifests.py:428-435) wrongly lists Gremlin. U-03 resolved: EOIP adapter has no SigV4 signing (Basic auth only; Neptune has no password auth).
decision_summary: INTEGRATE as optional (customer-requested) backend; BUILD SigV4 auth (P0 for Neptune customers), deterministic ~id identity, dialect profile, retry/batching; INTEGRATE Streams, S3 loader, Neptune Analytics as optional pushdowns; REJECT for air-gapped profiles

name: Azure Cosmos DB for Apache Gremlin
members: Azure Cosmos DB for Apache Gremlin
latest_version: Managed service (no engine version); recommended TinkerPop client drivers 3.4.13
release_cadence: Continuous managed service; Gremlin compatibility docs largely unchanged since 2019-2021
license: Proprietary Azure managed service; client drivers Apache TinkerPop (Apache-2.0)
redistribution_notes: Not redistributable; runs in the customer's Azure subscription. Client drivers Apache-2.0.
legal_review_reason: No copyleft; commercial review only for resale
community_vs_enterprise: Single managed tier; throughput modes provisioned / autoscale / serverless
resolution_note: No retirement/deprecation/feature-freeze announcement found (2026-10-18). All Gremlin docs carry a banner steering high-scale users to Cosmos DB for NoSQL and OLAP/Gremlin-migration users to Graph in Microsoft Fabric (GQL); vNext emulator is NoSQL-only; drivers pinned at 3.4.13 - inferred strategic de-emphasis (confidence 0.6). CosmosEscape Gremlin-gateway sandbox escape (reported 2025-11-20, disclosed 2026-07-30) fixed. EOIP has no adapter (protocol label only).
action_reason: User-named; retained as Tier B reference with DEFER decision on adapter support
decision_summary: DEFER adapter (contract-driven only); REJECT for air-gapped profiles; EXPERIMENT EOIP impact index for reverse traversals; BUILD query-parser fuzzing / no-dynamic-code rule
